_about: Hand-written from the code (base values, no upgrades). description: what the spell does (popup); tags: chips (only Good, Neutral, Evil, Order, Balance, Chaos); kind: where the spell goes on the page (common, event, alignment, faction, other), read with the tags; order (optional): the place within its group; detail (optional): note (faded text under the tags), sections (title, text, formulas, tags; "@penalty" stands for the shared Ascension penalty formula) and tier_sections (the bonus the spell gets at higher tiers). The tiers, their requirements, the tier cost and the offline bonus are generated by tools/build_spells_page.py from the Magic upgrades.
